title: Rental Car Damage Photo
scenario: A rental company message claims damage after return and asks you to pay through a link.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Rental Car Damage Photo: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Disputes should be handled through the rental company’s official process.
